text:
Nora Chen: opened PR to update Cumulus-13B model card with supported variants, a short limits table, and a Python SDK snippet for streaming. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/912
Luis Martinez: skimmed. Two immediate asks: 1) clarify the difference between base vs longctx variants (13k vs 65k) up front, 2) bench numbers need runtime + instance metadata.
Nora Chen: added a one-paragraph callout under Overview explaining base vs longctx and a small limits table showing both max_contexts. For benches I added "(measured on p4d, runtime v1.12)" and TODO to re-run.
Mira Patel: FYI our SDK v3 uses max_length instead of max_tokens/max_seq. The snippet still uses max_tokens. Can you swap and test streaming locally?
Nora Chen: swapping now. Also changed the code block to use client.generate_stream(..., max_length=2048) and tested in a dev env.
Ivy: small suggestion: in "Known limits" add a recommended chunking pattern for prompts > max_context. One-liner should be enough.
Nora Chen: added chunking example and a short note recommending the longctx variant for >13k sequences.
Samira (docs-bot): linkcheck report: 1 broken anchor (bench results). Suggest linking to /internals/benchmarks#cumulus-13b instead of relative anchor. Spellcheck OK.
Nora Chen: fixed the bench link and pushed. Also created ticket INF-1955 to re-run full benchmarks on runtime v1.14 and linked it in the PR.
Luis Martinez: can we add a compat note for the quant variant? folks need to know it may fall back to fp16 when kernels missing and that perf degrades after ~32k sequences.
Nora Chen: added compat row for cumulus-13b-quant with fallback note and a short recommendation: "Use cumulus-13b-fp16 for sustained long-context workloads".
Mira Patel: left a couple of tiny nits on wording. Non-blocking.
Samira (docs-bot): render check passed after latest push. Merge window OK (02:00-09:00 UTC).
Nora Chen: pinging docs-team for approval. If green, will merge tomorrow morning.
Luis Martinez: approved. Mira?
Mira Patel: approving.
Samira (docs-bot): PR merged by Nora Chen at 4523457040. Changelog updated: "cumulus-13b: add variants, limits table, chunking guidance, SDK snippet update, bench link fix"
Ivy: thanks everyone, closing loop.
